a reliable source: I heard the news from a reliable source, so I'm sure the concert has really been canceled.
我是從可靠的消息來源聽到這個消息的，所以我確定演唱會真的取消了。
reliable information: Wikipedia is useful, but you should check other websites to make sure you're getting reliable information.
維基百科很有用，但你應該查看其他網站，確定你得到的是可靠的資訊。
a reliable car: My dad's old Toyota is a reliable car; it has never broken down in fifteen years.
我爸那台舊的豐田是性能可靠的車，十五年來從沒拋錨過。
reliable evidence: The police needed reliable evidence, like fingerprints or video, before they could arrest the man.
警方需要可信的證據，例如指紋或影片，才能逮捕那名男子。
a reliable witness: The judge decided the drunk man was not a reliable witness, since he could not remember what happened that night.
法官認定那名喝醉的男子不是可信的證人，因為他記不得那晚發生了什麼事。
religious beliefs: In our class, students have different religious beliefs, but everyone respects one another's faith.
我們班上的學生有不同的宗教信仰，但大家都尊重彼此的信仰。
religious freedom: In a country with religious freedom, people can choose to worship any god or none at all.
在有宗教自由的國家，人們可以選擇信奉任何神明，或者完全不信。
with religious zeal: She studies English with religious zeal, practicing for three hours every single day without missing one.
她以宗教般的熱情學英文，每天練習三小時，一天都沒漏掉。
religious devotion: Every morning the old man prays at the temple, showing his strong religious devotion to the gods.
那位老先生每天早上都到廟裡祈禱，展現他對神明虔誠的信仰。
be reluctant to admit: Even after seeing the video, he was still reluctant to admit he had cheated, insisting it was someone else.
即使看了影片，他仍然不願承認自己作弊，堅稱是別人做的。
a reluctant hero: He became a reluctant hero after saving a child from the river; he hated all the attention from reporters.
他從河裡救起一個孩子後成了不情願的英雄，他很討厭記者對他的關注。
give a reluctant nod: My mom didn't want me to go camping, but she had to give a reluctant nod when my teacher promised to come along.
我媽不想讓我去露營，但當我的老師答應一起去時，她只好勉強點頭。
with reluctant agreement: Dad finally accepted my plan with reluctant agreement, even though he still thought studying abroad was too expensive.
爸爸最後勉強同意了我的計畫，儘管他仍覺得出國念書太貴了。
a remarkable achievement: Winning a gold medal at just fifteen years old is a remarkable achievement for any athlete.
年僅十五歲就贏得金牌，對任何運動員來說都是非凡的成就。
be remarkable for: The town is remarkable for its beautiful old temples, which attract thousands of tourists every year.
這個小鎮以美麗的古老寺廟著稱，每年吸引數千名觀光客。
remarkable progress: Since she started reading English novels, she has made remarkable progress in her vocabulary.
自從她開始讀英文小說，她的字彙有了顯著的進步。
It is remarkable that…: It is remarkable that the old man still runs ten kilometers every morning at the age of ninety.
那位老先生九十歲了每天早上還跑十公里，真是很了不起。
a remote possibility: There is only a remote possibility that it will snow in Taipei, so don't expect a white Christmas.
台北下雪的可能性極小，所以別期待會有白色聖誕節。
remote control: My little brother always hides the TV remote control so that no one else can change the channel.
我弟弟總是把電視遙控器藏起來，讓其他人都不能轉台。
a remote village: The doctor often travels to a remote village in the mountains, where there is no hospital for miles.
那位醫生常常前往山裡一個偏遠的村莊，那裡方圓數哩都沒有醫院。
the remote past: Dinosaurs lived in the remote past, millions of years before the first humans appeared.
恐龍生活在遙遠的過去，比最早的人類出現早了數百萬年。
remote learning: During the pandemic, schools switched to remote learning, and students took classes online from home.
疫情期間，學校改為遠距學習，學生在家上網上課。
work remotely: Since the company lets her work remotely, she can live in Hualien and still keep her job in Taipei.
因為公司讓她遠端工作，她可以住在花蓮，同時保有在台北的工作。
not have the remotest idea: I don't have the remotest idea where I put my keys; I've looked everywhere in the house.
我完全不知道我把鑰匙放在哪裡了，家裡每個地方我都找過了。
a remote ancestor: According to family records, a remote ancestor of ours came to Taiwan from China more than three hundred years ago.
根據族譜記載，我們的一位遠祖在三百多年前從中國來到台灣。
be representative of: These five students are representative of the whole class, so their opinions show what most classmates think.
這五位學生可以代表全班，所以他們的意見反映了大多數同學的想法。
a representative sample: To get accurate results, the survey used a representative sample of teenagers from both cities and villages.
為了得到準確的結果，這份調查採用了來自城市和鄉村青少年的具代表性的樣本。
a sales representative: She works as a sales representative for a phone company, visiting customers to sell new products.
她在一家手機公司擔任業務代表，拜訪客戶推銷新產品。
the House of Representatives: In the United States, the House of Representatives and the Senate must both pass a bill before it becomes law.
在美國，法案必須經眾議院和參議院都通過才能成為法律。
elected representatives: Citizens can write letters to their elected representatives to tell them what problems the city should solve.
市民可以寫信給他們的民選代表，告訴他們城市應該解決哪些問題。
